}}'''Karl Jakobs''' is [[Professor]] of [[Particle Physics]] at the [[University of Freiburg]], Germany.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://portal.uni-freiburg.de/jakobs |title=Experimentelle Teilchenphysik — Abteilung Prof. Karl Jakobs |language=de |publisher=Portal.uni-freiburg.de |date= |accessdate=2017-06-17}}</ref> He was the Spokesperson (scientific head) of the [[ATLAS experiment|ATLAS]] Collaboration at the [[Large Hadron Collider]] at [[CERN]] from 2017 to 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://atlas.cern/updates/atlas-news/new-management-atlas-experiment |title=New Management at the ATLAS Experiment &#124; ATLAS Experiment at CERN |publisher=Atlas.cern |date= |accessdate=2017-06-17}}</ref>

==Education==
Jakobs studied at the [[University of Bonn]] and received his [[Diplom]] in 1984. He went to the [[Heidelberg University]] to study the properties of the production of [[W and Z bosons]] in proton-proton collisions and received his [[PhD]] in 1988.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://portal.uni-freiburg.de/jakobs/jak |title=Prof. Dr. Karl Jakobs — Abteilung Prof. Karl Jakobs |language=de |publisher=Portal.uni-freiburg.de |date= |accessdate=2017-06-20}}</ref>

==Awards==
In 2015 Karl Jakobs was awarded the [[Stern–Gerlach Medal]] for his contributions to the discovery of the [[Higgs boson]].<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Fleischhauer |first1=Michael |last2=Kocharovskaya |first2=Olga |last3=Blatt |first3=Rainer |last4=Ye |first4=Jun |date=2025 |title=Preisträgerinnen und Preisträger |url=https://www.dpg-physik.de/auszeichnungen/dpg-preise-mit-anderen-organisationen/herbert-walther-preis/preistraeger |access-date=30 June 2025 |website=www.dpg-physik.de}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.dpg-physik.de/preise/preistraeger_sg.html |title=Preisträger Stern-Gerlach nach Jahren |publisher=Dpg-physik.de |date=2016-11-17 |accessdate=2017-06-17 }}{{Dead link|date=March 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
